collection.description: A child is upset after seeing a bird catch an insect.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) is upset after seeing a bird catch an insect.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a feast, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a naturalist, explains that animals need energy to survive.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) learns that predators are not cruel for eating.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) is allowed to feel sad for the insect.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) decides to watch birds from farther away.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (elder) shares a belief about the circle of life without presenting it as fact.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) asks whether nature can be both beautiful and sad.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) learns that different animals eat different foods.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) discovers that some animals eat both plants and other animals.
